title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay San Rafael I, City of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan to Be Known as San Rafael National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay San Rafael I, City of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan to Be Known as San Rafael National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay San Rafael I, Thành phố San Jose Del Monte, Tỉnh Bulacan được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia San Rafael
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ San Rafael I, เมือง San Jose Del Monte, จังหวัด Bulacan ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ San Rafael
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay San Rafael I, Kota San Jose Del Monte, Provinsi Bulacan dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional San Rafael
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay San Rafael I, Bandaraya San Jose Del Monte, Wilayah Bulacan dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan San Rafael

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay San Rafael I, City of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan to be known as San Rafael National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the San Rafael National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
